product: E2B sandboxes in OpenAI Agents SDK
source_title: E2B is now supported in the OpenAI Agents SDK
claim_summary: Vendor states E2B is a sandbox provider in the new OpenAI Agents SDK giving agents isolated file/shell workspaces with persistence and parallel sandboxes; cookbook examples linked
availability: Python Agents SDK only at publication; TypeScript support stated as upcoming
limitation: OpenAI page lists several sandbox providers so this is not exclusive; openai.com page returned by search but direct fetch returned HTTP 403 so OpenAI wording not read in full

claim_summary: Release notes: prevent shell injection in MCP config by proper shell escaping (shlex.quote in Python and a shellQuote helper in JS/TS)
limitation: No GHSA advisory published for the repo at access time; affected version range and exploitability not stated

source_title: E2B Sandboxes Aren't Affected by Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431). Here's why.
claim_summary: Vendor states sandboxes are not affected by Linux kernel CVE-2026-31431 because each sandbox runs its own Firecracker microVM kernel and the AF_ALG AEAD user crypto options are not compiled in
limitation: Not an independent audit; CVE facts come from third-party advisories (search-returned) but the non-exposure claim is unverified; host kernel status not disclosed

claim_summary: Same-day releases deprecate autoPause in favour of a lifecycle on_timeout setting and remove the Sandbox.betaCreate beta method
availability: released; breaking removal of beta method
limitation: Breaking-change and migration cost for downstream users not measured

claim_summary: Release adds structured network rules with per-host transforms and Sandbox.updateNetwork to replace a running sandbox's egress allow/deny configuration
availability: released in SDK; server support assumed
limitation: Foundation later used for header injection; enforcement correctness not independently tested

source_title: E2B offers agent code sandboxes to a16z Speedrun founders
claim_summary: Secondary report that E2B launched an offer giving a16z Speedrun founders access to its sandboxes; article says pricing credits limits and duration undisclosed
limitation: Aggregator citing an X post via another outlet; no primary E2B page located for this offer; not adoption evidence

claim_summary: CLI restricts ~/.e2b/config.json to 0600 and ~/.e2b to 0700 to stop other local users reading the stored access token and team API key
limitation: Earlier CLI versions left credentials readable per release note; exposure window and affected users unknown

source_title: E2B sandboxes are now available through Stripe Projects
claim_summary: Vendor joins Stripe Projects developer preview so agents can provision E2B sandboxes and receive rotatable env-var credentials via Stripe CLI using the Agentic Provisioning Protocol
limitation: Protocol stated as still evolving; search snippet showed a different CLI argument than the .md page read; Stripe-side terms not reviewed

claim_summary: CLI replaces legacy access-token auth with an OAuth 2.0 PKCE refresh-token flow; old flat configs deprecated and require re-login
limitation: Docs say access-token deprecation was announced 2026-06-22; that announcement page itself was not located

claim_summary: Changelog: fork a running sandbox into one or more clones from its in-memory state (JS SDK 2.35.0 / Python 2.34.0); snapshot name filter; Docker-compatible template copy
limitation: Fork fidelity, isolation between forks and cost not independently tested; fork count limits changed later

source_title: Use E2B as the Execution Layer For Devin Outposts
claim_summary: Vendor guide states Devin Outposts sessions can run on E2B microVMs via E2B Bring Your Own Cloud with snapshot pause/resume
availability: guide published; BYOC is an enterprise offering
limitation: Cognition-side documentation not located in this screen; availability tied to enterprise plans

claim_summary: Status page records degraded performance of sandbox pause/resume/create in US-West-1 from resource exhaustion, resolved the same day
limitation: Times shown without timezone; impact size not stated; one of 17 incidents listed Jul 22 to Oct 2 on the status history

claim_summary: Changelog: as of Aug 1 access tokens no longer accepted and V1 template builds stop; templates gain Fedora Alpine Arch and NixOS base images
limitation: Migration burden on CI pipelines not measured; V1 build users forced to migrate

source_title: Workload Identity in the SDKs & Faster Python HTTP (August 17, 2026)
claim_summary: Changelog: Sandbox.create takes iam.tokens for short-lived workload identity tokens injected into egress headers without the SDK seeing their value; Python SDK moves to a Rust HTTP stack
availability: SDK support shipped; runtime release notes describe admission as feature-gated
limitation: Gating/plan availability unclear; a later Sep 28 fix addressed tokens vanishing in the final minute of sandbox life

source_title: Bring Your Own Proxy & Sandbox List Filters (August 24, 2026)
claim_summary: Changelog: network.egressProxy tunnels outbound TCP through a customer SOCKS5 proxy applied on the host and failing closed; sandbox list filters and CLI snapshot commands
availability: SDK 2.41.0; Oct 5 changelog states bring-your-own-proxy is in private beta
limitation: Fail-closed and non-bypass claims are vendor assertions; not independently tested

source_title: Self-Hosted E2B Alternatives: 6 AI Agent Sandboxes Compared
claim_summary: Competitor describes self-hosting E2B as a project needing Terraform plus Nomad/Consul with GCP full and AWS beta support; SDK Apache-2.0 and infra public
limitation: Publisher sells a competing product; predates Embed release; not a controlled test

claim_summary: Cursor changelog lists E2B among sandbox platforms on which Cursor cloud agents' self-hosted workers can run tool execution
availability: counterparty-documented; requires Cursor Enterprise per E2B docs
limitation: Counterparty listing, not usage evidence; E2B templates arrived in Sep 7 changelog

source_title: Elevated errors levels on US cluster from internal migration
claim_summary: Status page: during an internal migration a subset of US-cluster traffic errored with a stated peak of about 15 percent error rate; resolved about 20 minutes after identification
limitation: Linked write-up not read; timezone not shown

claim_summary: Changelog: cursor-agents dispatcher and worker templates run Cursor Self-Hosted Machines on E2B with one worker sandbox per request; Workspaces rolling out; NeMo Gym Agno and Muse Code guides
limitation: Same integration as Cursor Sep 2 changelog; not an independent second event

claim_summary: Changelog fix: commands in a resumed sandbox ran as root instead of the default user after a platform upgrade; affected sandboxes recover on next resume
limitation: Exposure window and number of affected sandboxes not stated; inside-VM privilege only per description

source_title: Build an Agent Workbench on OpenAI's Agents API
claim_summary: Vendor guide pairs OpenAI's hosted Agents API (beta) with one E2B sandbox per chat; application-managed and webhook-managed provisioning; pause and fork
availability: depends on OpenAI Agents API preview/beta access
limitation: Sub-60ms cold start is a vendor claim; OpenAI provider page confirms modes but shows no date

claim_summary: Open-source runtime release removes access-token auth and adds feature-gated secrets CRUD (metadata-only responses) and workload identity configuration
limitation: Release notes link to e2b-dev/infra which now redirects to e2b-dev/runtime; rename date not verified

claim_summary: Changelog adds E2B Embed self-hosted deployments via Docker Compose Terraform or Kubernetes with pinned images; SDKs retry 429; Volumes and Secrets stated as private beta
availability: code and changelog entry published before launch blog
limitation: Changelog date precedes the Sep 30 launch post for the same product; treat as one event group

source_title: V2 Sandbox Endpoints & CLI Sandbox Fork (September 21, 2026)
claim_summary: Changelog: SDKs call v2 create/connect endpoints and every sandbox is secured (secure option ignored); CLI sandbox fork; V1 template build endpoints removed
limitation: Security effect of default secured access not independently tested

claim_summary: Vendor releases Embed: open-source Apache-2.0 single-machine E2B runtime plus dashboard for customer environments; Firecracker sandboxes; OTel export; no account or license key needed
availability: released; excludes secrets volumes workload identity and BYO proxy
limitation: Single-machine only; KVM host required; serves plain HTTP inside network per post; scale and security untested here

claim_summary: Vendor declares Secrets GA: stored encrypted secrets are injected into configured HTTPS request headers outside the sandbox so code inside never holds the value; write-only management API; rotation without restart
availability: GA for E2B Cloud; BYOC support coming soon; private beta per Sep 14 changelog
limitation: Header injection protects only configured HTTPS destinations; misuse via allowed destination remains possible; no independent audit

claim_summary: Changelog: filesystem-only snapshot mode (keepMemory deprecated); deprecated POST /sandboxes now always enables secured access; Azure deployment for Embed; per-project Secrets dashboard page
limitation: Old templates must be rebuilt for secured access; maintenance cost not measured
